Id1.text: The All India Council for Technical Education, located in Mumbai, was proud to give Technical Campus status to the Acharya Institute of Technology, located in Bangalore, India, a city founded by Kempe Gowda I. Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar is the director of the Acharya Institute of Technology. The campus address is Acharya Institute of Technology, Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore - 560090.
